decision_conditions: 1. The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition, representing an overly dominant and excessive addition to the dwelling. The rear extension would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and fails to remain within 45 degrees as taken from the corner of the neighbouring dwellings. The front gable extension would not sit comfortably within the existing pattern of development, impacting the character of the terrace dwelling and existing context of the area.  The accumulative impact of the first floor rear extension and front gable roof extension would result in the creation of a significantly developed and out of proportion roof form and impacting the symmetry of the terrace building.  As such, the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design: - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)

2. The proposed development by reason of its scale, siting, design, depth, massing and bulk would negatively impact neighbouring amenities. The first floor rear extension would introduce a significant level of overbearing, loss of outlook, loss of privacy, overshadowing and loss of daylight towards adjoining neighbours, significantly impacting the existing amenity and constituting undue harm. As such, the proposed development is contrary to: - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)
description: Proposed first floor rear extension, front facade alterations including two rooflights and front gable roof, internal alterations and all associated works
